description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class called LogFragment which contains a LogView used for displaying log data within an Android application. It manages UI components like ScrollView and LogView, inflates views programmatically, and sets up a text change listener to scroll the log view to the bottom when new logs are added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that creates and manages a UI component for displaying logs using a LogView inside a ScrollView. It handles view inflation, layout setup, and ensures logs are scrolled to the bottom as they update.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView components programmatically, setting layout parameters, typeface, padding, and other visual properties.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, adds a TextChangedListener to the LogView to keep the scroll at the bottom on updates, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
